Coram : DIPAK MISRA*, V. GOPALA GOWDA
Penal Code, 1860 - s. 304 Part II, s. 300 Exception 4 - Murder - Scuffle between accused-husband and wife and the C deceased, resulting in the death of the victim - Complainant and others witness to the incident - Conviction and sentence u/s. 302 - Accused pleading provocation on the part of of evidence, however, order passed by trial court upheld by High Court - On appeal, held: Death of D the victim was homicidal in the light of the evidence produced by prosecution witnesses - There was no premeditation on the part of the accused and the scuffle took place due to sudden
Decision Date : 25-09-2014 | Case No : CRIMINAL APPEAL No. 111/2008 | Disposal Nature : Disposed off | Bench : 2 Judges
